sync.deletion_skipped: {p0}: {p1} items missing from TeslaMate, deletion skipped for safety (check the TeslaMate vehicle identifier)
sync.deleted_upstream: {p0}: {p1} item(s) deleted in TeslaMate, excluded from the calculations
sync.page_failed: {p0} (page {p1}): {p2} - the import resumes at the next synchronization
sync.page_limit: {p0}: limit of {p1} pages reached, history partially imported
sync.odometer_lower: TeslaMate odometer ({p0} {unit}) is lower than the recorded odometer ({p1} {unit}): check the vehicle's manual entries

assumption.usage: {p0} {unit}/year for {p1} year(s), same usage for both vehicles
assumption.depreciation: Depreciation = (purchase price − resale) spread linearly over the period
assumption.no_financing: Financing, loans and leases not included
assumption.break_even: The break-even compares cumulative outlays (purchase + running costs), without resale
assumption.ev_actual: Reference side: recorded costs per {unit}, including fuel and electricity for hybrids (insurance and depreciation included)
assumption.ev_price_unknown: Reference purchase price unknown (lease or missing entry): depreciation not included
assumption.ev_no_distance: No tracked mileage: recorded costs cannot provide a reliable comparison

comparison.defaults_source: Indicative values for France, to adjust

tire.wear_explanation: {p0}, {p1}: average power peaks of +{p2} kW and {p3} kW in regeneration, consumption {p4} kWh/100 {unit}. Stress index: x{p5} (estimated lifespan adjusted to ~{p6} {unit}).
